about: What /changelog leaves out (founder, 2026-11-07, krizaka-internal#2832): the team's internal work, which a visitor cannot see. Each kind is a pattern on one line of a release, with its reason. Security and breaking changes are always kept. The repositories' CHANGELOG.md and GitHub releases stay complete; this rule only shapes the public page and its feed.

internal.why: CI, workflows, pipelines and smoke runs
lint, format and static-analysis fixes (Sonar rule ids, regexes, ternaries)
tests, test classes, end-to-end journeys and test personas
where the code lives and how it is built: folders, clones, build order
the development hosts and what only they show
